subject: Idea for Sanctuary Salon & Med Spa
body:
Hi,

I came across Sanctuary and spent some time looking through your services and space. What stood out most was the combination of the med spa and full salon under one roof — the range of treatments means a guest's experience can move from clinical precision into pure sensory calm in a single visit.

From what I saw, Sanctuary already has a strong brand, but I think the content could lean more into the ritual flow of the experience — the private treatment room atmosphere, the quieter moments between services — so the viewer feels the actual pace and care rather than just a list of treatments.

I create luxury travel UGC built around that kind of experience-led storytelling. The concept I had for Sanctuary would be a slow, immersive piece centered on a treatment sequence, using the space and detail to make the experience feel grounded and elevated.

Happy to send over the full angle I had in mind for Sanctuary.

Best,
Malachi
